tool.setting.emittertool.basedef.descrip: The physical emitter body to spawn.
tool.setting.emittertool.effectdef.descr: The particle effect the emitter will produce.
tool.setting.camera_key.description: Your input for viewing this camera. On its own it works anywhere for its owner. Attached to something with a seat, it works for whoever is sitting in it, and leaving the seat ends the view. When several cameras share a binding, a new view uses the most recently enabled one.
tool.setting.camera_static.description: A static camera cannot be picked up with physics tools or unfrozen. Other tool cameras start frozen but can be unfrozen normally.
tool.setting.camera_toggle.description: Enabled: press to enter the camera view, press again to leave. Disabled: hold the input to view the camera.
tool.setting.light_input.description: The linked seat input or signal that controls the light. Toggle switches on each press; hold mode stays on while the input is held.
tool.setting.light_toggle.description: Enabled: each press switches the light on or off. Disabled: the light is only on while the key or trigger signal is held.
tool.setting.speaker_range_preview.descr: Draw range rings on the placement surface. Rings become fainter as volume falls with distance.
tool.setting.speakertool.hidden.descript: No model or collision. Sticks to what you place it on, and shows as an icon in the inspect menu (hold C).
tool.setting.stackertool.alignmode.descr: Whether to align the stack axis to the world or the target object.
tool.setting.stackertool.angleoffsetx.de: Rotation offset in degrees around the first perpendicular axis. For up or down stacking, this is the right axis.
tool.setting.stackertool.angleoffsety.de: Rotation offset in degrees around the second perpendicular axis. For up or down stacking, this is the forward axis.
Extra gap in units between each stacked copy.
tool.setting.stackertool.freezeall.descr: Freeze the stacked copies so they cannot move.
tool.setting.builder.shape.description: The shape stretched to fill the drawn block.
tool.setting.builder.thickness.descripti: Wall thickness of some building blocks
tool.setting.builder.grid.description: Grid spacing in units. Shift + scroll changes it, hold Snap to place off grid.
tool.setting.builder.adjacent.descriptio: Allows snapping to lines coming from the corners and snap points of adjacent building blocks.
tool.setting.builder.symmetry.descriptio: The first point becomes the centre of the block, and its sides mirror around it as you place the second point. Press T to toggle.
tool.setting.builder.surface.description: Physical surface for sounds, impacts and friction. Empty uses the default.
tool.setting.builder.collisions.descript: Collide with props and players. Off still collides with the world, can be selected by tools and turned back on from the Inspector.
tool.setting.hoverballentity.speed.descr: How fast the target height changes when inputs are held.
tool.setting.hoverballentity.airresistan: Horizontal air resistance applied while hovering. Also increases vertical damping.
tool.setting.hoverballentity.up.descript: While held, raises the hover target.
tool.setting.hoverballentity.down.descri: While held, lowers the hover target.
tool.setting.hoverballentity.toggle.desc: Toggles the hoverball on or off.
tool.setting.lengthconstraintentity.acti: While this input is active, extend towards full length.
tool.setting.motorentity.startactive.des: Spins on its own as soon as it is created, without needing a driver or wire signal.
tool.setting.slider_friction.description: How hard the slider resists moving. Zero slides freely.
tool.setting.slider_max_length.descripti: How far apart the two points can slide, in units. Zero keeps them within the distance you placed them at.
tool.setting.motorentity.forward.descrip: While held, spins forward regardless of the Reversed or Start Active settings.
tool.setting.motorentity.reverse.descrip: While held, spins backward regardless of the Reversed or Start Active settings.
tool.setting.thrusterentity.activate.des: While this input is active, apply thrust.
tool.setting.thrusterentity.reverse.desc: While this input is active, apply thrust in the opposite direction.
tool.setting.thrusterentity.thrustersoun: Looping sound played while the thruster is active.
tool.setting.line_height.description: Space between lines, as a multiple of the font's own. Only shows with more than one line.
tool.setting.collisions.description: Lets players and objects bump into the text. Without it everything passes through, the physgun can still move it.
tool.setting.gravity.description: Lets the text fall. Needs collisions, so it has something to land on.
tool.setting.font_weight.description: How bold the text is. Not every font has every weight, those without it use their closest one.
tool.signal.angleoutput.description: The current angle, normalized so a full turn is 1.
tool.hint.trail.description: Add or remove trails from objects
